cases.title: Plan a host-facing runtime configuration message
cases.prompt: Plan a new host-facing runtime configuration request and response consumed by firmware, the Rust CLI, and Flutter. Identify the schema authority, generated consumers, response envelope, and required verification. Do not implement it.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; do not access devices or GitHub.

cases.title: Review a response-envelope mismatch
cases.prompt: Identify the authoritative firmware and host locations when a config response is decoded with the wrong status envelope. Distinguish wrapped responses from bare protobuf list, diagnostic, and unsolicited payloads and name the tests required before changes.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; do not open a transport.

cases.title: Review an interrupt-driven firmware change
cases.prompt: Review rules and implementation areas for a new interrupt-driven input driver. Identify ISR, allocation, logging, FreeRTOS API, ownership, host-test, build, and hardware constraints.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; do not flash firmware.

cases.title: Plan a new CLI diagnostics command
cases.prompt: Plan a domes-cli diagnostics command backed by an existing protobuf request. Identify command registration, protocol handling, transport independence, tests, and required CLI checks. Do not implement it.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; do not change the device registry.

cases.title: Review stale BLE drill completions
cases.prompt: Trace the Flutter architecture when a stopped or superseded drill receives a late BLE touch or asynchronous completion. Identify owning providers, transport, protocol, tests, and the physical verification gate.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; do not access Bluetooth.

cases.title: Resolve a current-versus-proposed documentation conflict
cases.prompt: A historical research document describes a production board and feature as delivered, while implementation and milestones disagree. Identify the authority order and how to update docs without promoting a proposal to as-built status.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; leave documentation unchanged.

cases.title: Audit OTA rollback verification claims
cases.prompt: Audit evidence required to claim OTA update and rollback behavior are verified. Distinguish first and second boots, interrupted recovery, and deliberately forced failed-self-test rollback. Identify authoritative workflows and implementation surfaces.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; do not transfer an image or reboot.

cases.title: Plan a two-pod ESP-NOW investigation
cases.prompt: Plan a two-pod ESP-NOW investigation without hardware. Distinguish CP2102N protocol ports from native USB console/JTAG, stable identity from kernel numbering, CLI fan-out from monitoring, and trace-correlation limits.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; do not open serial or BLE interfaces.

cases.title: Keep a documentation-only change scoped
cases.prompt: Describe how to correct one broken repository-relative link without broad cleanup. Identify the checker, narrow verification, and which firmware, CLI, Flutter, and hardware checks are unnecessary.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; do not edit files.

cases.title: Review an intentionally unsafe firmware approach
cases.prompt: Review this proposal: allocate a std::vector and log from a GPIO ISR, call a blocking FreeRTOS API there, ignore esp_err_t, and validate only with host tests. Identify violations, alternatives, files, and verification.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; never create the unsafe code.

cases.title: Assess a WiFi transport verification request
cases.prompt: Assess whether default firmware can validate WiFi/TCP config and raw TCP OTA on a clean board. Identify build requirements, credentials, supported routes, source files, and honest verification boundaries.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; leave network and device state untouched.

cases.title: Map a release-affecting firmware change to evidence
cases.prompt: Map evidence required for a change affecting release metadata, binary size, OTA identity, and factory packaging. Identify local verification, CI and release workflows, version extraction, and hardware gaps not proven by a build.
cases.cleanup: Remove the temporary worktree; do not create a release or tag.
